datasets.title: Myositis muscle
datasets.summary: Expression profiling of human myositis muscle samples This study was designed to compare expression signatures among the various types of inflammatory myopathy, dermatomyositis (DM), inclusion body myositis (IBM), necrotizing myopathy (NM), nonspecific myopathy (NS), and polymyositis (PM) compared to normal (NL) muscle.
datasets.overall_design: Muscle samples from human biopsies with DM, IBM, NM, NS, PM, or normal were studied for gene expression to identify differentially expressed genes.

datasets.title: Expression data from inflammatory myopathies
datasets.summary: MHC-I overexpression in muscle biopsies is a hallmark of inflammatory myopathies.However the mechanisms of MHC-I overexpression in each disease is not well understood. Microarray analysis from MHC-I-microdissected myofibers showed a differential expression signature in each inflammatory myopathy. Innate immunity and IFN-I pathways are upregulated vs healthy controls, specifically in dermatomyositis (DM).
datasets.overall_design: RNA from MHC-I-positive myofibers were obtained from muscle biopsies of 5 patients with dermatomyositis, 5 with polymyositis, 4 with inclusion body myositis and normal looking fibers from healthy controls.
